# Game Idea: Meteor Dodge

A simple HTML canvas game where the player controls a spaceship at the bottom of the screen, moving left and right to avoid falling meteors. Meteors spawn at random positions from the top and fall down at increasing speed. The game ends when a meteor collides with the ship. The score is the number of meteors avoided (time survived).
